title: Sefaria
notes: Official bulk exports provide JSON and TXT downloads; the developer documentation describes the REST API. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, after corpus deduplication).
license_note: Each text version carries its own licence in the JSON license field; there is no repository-wide text licence.

resource_statistics.note: Counted 1,043 individual Hebrew source versions of 897 works whose entire recorded composition-date range lies within 1450–1700. Includes repeated content across editions; excludes generated merged files and translations. Undated and boundary-crossing works require review. Official export dated 2026-10-02, checked 2026-10-09.
